categories.label: GHG emissions
categories.description: Greenhouse gases by gas, process or source; includes CO2-equivalent totals.

categories.label: Air pollutants
categories.description: Non-GHG emissions to air: acidifying gases, particulates, ozone precursors, heavy metals, persistent organic pollutants and ozone-depleting halocarbons.

categories.label: Materials
categories.description: Extraction and use of biomass, fossil fuels, ores and minerals; crop and fish production.

categories.label: Land
categories.description: Land use and occupation, cropland and pasture areas, forest and deforestation attribution.

categories.label: Water
categories.description: Water withdrawal, consumption and water footprints.

categories.label: Waste
categories.description: Waste supply and use, waste treatment and material stock additions.

categories.label: Employment & labour
categories.description: Persons employed, hours worked, skill and gender splits, labour compensation.

categories.label: Economic accounts
categories.description: Value added components, gross output, intermediate inputs, capital, prices and volumes supplied as satellite rows.

categories.label: Other
categories.description: Emissions to water and soil, nutrients, crop yields, health-weighted emissions and placeholders.

families.note: GHG accounts are published, and loaded, only for some ADB releases.
CEDA publishes characterised emission factors only; there are no satellite accounts by sector.
Eurostat publishes FIGARO-based emission footprints, not direct emissions by industry under open terms; non-European emissions derive from EDGAR/IEA (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0).
The MARIO parser reads GTAP emission blocks, but GTAP data are licensed and not parsed for this documentation.
OECD publishes ICIO-based CO2/GHG footprint indicators built on IEA emission statistics, not openly licensed direct emissions by industry.
No environmental accounts are published with the 2016 release; socio-economic accounts are loaded.
